name: Kimono
tagline: Kimono and yukata portraits in temples, gardens and lantern-lit streets.
description: Kimono and summer yukata photographed with respect in Kyoto's old lanes, torii-lined shrine paths, bamboo groves, cherry-blossom rivers, moss gardens, tea houses and snowy temples, plus summer festivals and riverside fireworks. Correct obi, haori and hakama styling.
